subject: DHCP pool exhaustion causing new devices unable to connect to network
description: Multiple staff members report that new devices (tablets, smartphones) are unable to obtain IP addresses and connect to the store Wi-Fi network. The NetLink NL-3000 router appears to be running out of available DHCP addresses, with existing connections remaining stable but new connection attempts timing out. This issue started this morning around 7:30 AM and is impacting POS terminal setup and guest Wi-Fi access. No recent configuration changes were made to the router.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and assigned. Initial assessment confirms DHCP issue; L1 recommended checking DHCP pool size and connected device count. Escalation flagged due to business impact.
